Key scientific variables separating them include variable thunderstorm timing—which can cap afternoon maxima through increased albedo and evaporative cooling—urban heat-island effects amplifying readings at city stations versus airports, and model spread in boundary-layer moisture and wind patterns. Official forecasts from sources like the Malaysian Meteorological Department and international models show 31–33°C ranges, with any late-day convection or thicker haze likely determining whether the high settles at the lower or upper end of that narrow band.

Remaining uncertainty stems from possible afternoon marine layer intrusion or minor forecast adjustments before the daily high is recorded, keeping modest probability on the 86–87°F bin.

eventMetadata.context_description:
**Close market-implied odds between 29°C (31%) and 30°C (30%) reflect forecast uncertainty in afternoon convective timing and cloud cover for Taipei on June 16.** 

Official Central Weather Administration guidance calls for mostly cloudy skies with occasional showers or thunderstorms, limiting insolation and capping the daily maximum near 29°C under a moist, southwesterly monsoon flow typical of the Meiyu season. Ensemble model spreads arise mainly from differences in the timing of localized thunderstorms, which can either suppress peaks through persistent cloud decks or allow brief clear intervals that push readings to 30°C. Historical June climatology shows average highs near 31–32°C, but recent frontal passages have trended cooler and wetter, keeping trader sentiment tightly balanced between these two outcomes while assigning lower probability to 28°C or 31°C thresholds. Updated model runs and CWA briefings ahead of the diurnal heating maximum will likely drive the final repricing.

Historical June averages in Manila hover near 32 °C, so the current forecast sits slightly above the long-term mean yet remains well below extreme-heat thresholds. Recent model consensus emphasizes modest steering winds and moderate moisture, reducing the likelihood of prolonged clear skies that would push readings to 36 °C or higher (combined <7 %). 

Key resolution factors include the exact timing and coverage of afternoon thunderstorms; any delay in monsoon activity could shift odds modestly higher, while earlier or heavier rain would favor the 33 °C outcome.
